'''Amos Rike''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[General/Legends|General]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. Rike was a strong Republic loyalist with a history of exceeding his orders to fulfill what he viewed as his duty to the Republic.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=codex|Alliance Intelligence Report: General Amos Rike}}</ref> When the [[Eternal Alliance]] rose to prominence as a new major power in the galaxy while utilizing a large number of Republic defectors in its ranks, Rike went to view it as the Republic's enemy regardless of the current political situation. Following the death of the [[Eternal Empire]] Empress [[Vaylin]] in [[3630 BBY]], Rike led a [[Rike's Raiders|group of loyalists]] including Captain [[Dakarus Garnik]], Lieutenant [[Jom Shomo]] and Major [[Nayva Isoder]] to [[Assault on Denova|displace]] the Alliance forces on [[Denova]] and seize control of the Denovan [[Baradium Mine]]s. Alliance Admiral [[Bey'wan Aygo]], who knew Rike back from his Republic days, sent a strike team to Denova to reclaim control of the mines. Rike's followers were taken out one by one, and eventually Rike himself confronted the Alliance forces in a [[Prototype hover tank|prototype]] [[Hovertank/Legends|hovertank]], claiming the mines were stolen from the Republic in the first place. After his hovertank was damaged, Rike proclaimed that impossible odds were no reason to surrender and engaged his opponents directly, but was overwhelmed and killed. After his death, Aygo proclaimed that Rike, though misguided, was a true Republic patriot.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
General Amos Rike appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' as the final boss of the "Trench Runner" Uprising.
